# Language cases: key

Invented text for DMbot's tests (#4229 slice 1d; Supervisor's ruling A). Every name and line is made up; the four player characters are the sample's, by name only. Files: [language_cases_lore.txt](language_cases_lore.txt), [language_cases_session.txt](language_cases_session.txt), [language_cases_key.json](language_cases_key.json).

| Line | Case | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | heard used | Okthandom Korran: Dwarvish |
| 3 | heard used (the DM's NPC) | Duna Kell: Dwarvish |
| 4 | heard used | Pell Arrow: Halfling |
| 5 | misheard ("Elfish") | Belleros Stormgrace: Elvish |
| 6 | named only (runes) | nothing |
| 7 | can't speak | nothing |
| 8 | a question | nothing |
| 9, 10 | no language | nothing |

A language heard for a character the campaign already has waits as a question for the DM (#4229 1c), so the check scores after the run's decide step. A player character with a sheet keeps its languages on the sheet and gets a private line instead, so a run that gives the four a sheet scores them as missed.
